items.excerpt: TIDAL announced it will label entirely AI-generated tracks and withhold royalty payments from them, planning to extend the 'AI' tag to substantially AI-generated music as detection tech improves.

FL Studio 2026 expands its Gopher AI assistant so it can now perform actions inside a project — organising tracks, routing mixer channels, setting levels, adjusting plugin parameters and generating Piano Roll content.

LANDR unveiled the next phase of its Fair Trade AI programme — a $1 million advance initiative letting independent musicians take upfront payments for licensing their catalogues to AI companies while staying eligible for recurring licensing revenue.

Sugar Bytes released a free DrumComputer Claude Extension that generates complete DrumComputer drum sounds and beats from a single natural-language text prompt, bringing an LLM directly into drum synthesis.

Hands-on review of Klang.io Transcription Studio, an AI tool that turns audio into notated transcriptions, lead sheets and guitar tabs — strong at single-instrument pitch detection but still an editing aid rather than a replacement for human transcribers.

WiseTracker is a free FastTracker 2-style tracker plugin and standalone app built by a lifelong tracker user who isn't a traditional developer — he used Claude to code it over several hundred hours, another example of AI lowering the barrier to building music tools.
